notes.title: Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved Full Release Announcement
notes.content:
Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved Full Release Announcement
After a period of internal development following the release of the EA version, we released the Prologue version as open test in May. After this test, we decided to full release the game on June 17 and will open a discount event in the near future!

[h2]Update content.[/h2]
1. The basic controls are heavily simplified and optimised, you now can command the zombie army smoothly.
2. The zombie generals are revamped, generals are buffed and clearly diversified.
3. The zombie king's magic arsenal is enriched, you now have more ways to deal with humans.
4.  Various lore pieces are placed around the world, and now you can finally discover interesting aspects of zombies and humans.
5. Normal zombies can devour human brains and thus use human weapons and carriers. When you see a decent human weapon, be sure to grab it!
6. Dogs and cows in the city can be zombified so you can use whoofs and moos as rallying cries now.
7. Destroying important buildings and killing important humans drop soul crystals, which provide random Artifacts to buff your armies to destroy human cities more effectively.
8. Killing more people and destroying more cities will allow you to gradually restore your zombie king and generals to their former power, and you can customize the evolution of your zombie army in any direction you like.
9. Updated voice acting resources, and some other convenience optimization
Note: Since the game has been drastically updated, you need to reopen an archive. Sorry for any inconvenience caused to you.

[h2]The Heart of Thundering Python DLC update[/h2]
Heart of Thundering Python is an ultimate artifact that once belonged to the Kingdom of Mist. This lost artifact is the key to unlocking mighty lightning powers for your zombie generals. 
To celebrate the full release, the Thunder Python Heart DLC will be given free with the game proper to players who purchase the game during the EA phase!
Price: $1.99 USD
Note: If you purchased the game during EA but did not unlock the DLC, please join our Discord server to contact the administrator with proof of purchase. We will send you a CDK as long as you provide us with proof.

[h2]Steam trading card and Achievement update[/h2]
We will also be releasing Steam Trading Cards and more than 20 achievements in the near future. Please refer to the actual version for the specific card style and achievement content.

Finally, thank you for your support and have fun!

Swarm the City Team

notes.title: Halloween Event Announcement
notes.content:
Humans are smashing pumpkins on the ground. Pumpkins! And they are gathering around the cities. Seems like they are celebrating something. It's a surprise seeing them putting their guards down and show their backs to us. Zombies, we will not miss this chance.

Our first DLC of Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved are now available! And it is completely free to access!

1. The Halloween Costume
- The Pop Star: A new skin for zombies and citizens.
- Pumpkinhead: A new skin for zombies

Check the store page first: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1702810/Swarm_the_City__Halloween_Costume/
Then get into the game, and check the battle preparation panel. You will find DLC right next to Map. That's where you can find and activate the DLCs you own.

notes.title: New Demo and Early Access Pre-Registration Announcement
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Pre-Pregistration for Early Access Has Started[/b][/i][/h3]
Big news! We have started the pre-registration of [i]Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved[/i]'s Early Access.

The early access will be available in September. We have set up a website for you to pre-register first. 

Pre-register now to get exclusive in-game rewards when it releases. Rewards include an Exclusive Zombie Skin, an Exclusive Building Skin, and 1,000 Air-Dried Eyeballs.

Link: https://zombie.xoyo.games/index.html#/

Please not: You will receive an email after you register. If you don't get it, please check your spam box. Sorry for the inconvenience. 

[h3][i][b]New Free Demo[/b][/i][/h3]
We just launched a new free demo. It will include the first five levels with a brand new UI design.

The demo can be access on [i]Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved[/i]'s steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597290/Swarm_the_City_Zombie_Evolved/

Hope you have a fun time playing the free demo. And if you like it, please add [i]Swarm the City: Zombie Evolved[/i] to your wishlist. :)

notes.content:
[i][b]What's New[/b][/i]

1. Players will now be led to the *Chapter Selection* page after finishing level 1-2. 

2. [i]Magic Mark[/i] and [i]Help[/i] are now both in the [i]Chapter Selection[/i] page. A new [i]Help[/i] icon will be added to the bottom left.

notes.title: Patch Note - June 22
notes.content:
1. Decreased the difficulty of Stage 1-2, 1-4, and TR3. 

2. Fixed a bug in stage 1-4 where Amalgadons might not grab objects even after they learned the skill needed. 

3. Adjusted the timing of unlocking the second general in stage 1-4.

4. Added a preloading function.

5. Fixed a bug that error message showed up when policy changed in stage 3-2.

6. Fixed stage 1-2 that players might get stuck and unable to finish the level.

7. Fixed the problem that numbers 3 and 4 to select zombie abilities are not functional. 

8. Fixed the bug in stage 3-1 that the airport missed the building description. 

9. Fixed the bug with volume setting. 

10. Fixed the bug that the boss might show up at the beginning of a level if players restart the level. 

11. Fixed the bug that pausing the game on the loading page might end the level and give victory to players immediately. 

12. Fixed the page overlay problem when players click to go back to the title screen.

13. Fixed the problem that the little tip icon above each zombie's head while entering a building might stay on the screen.

14. Fixed a problem that the charging number of Death Summon won't update when a player has his mouse on it.

15. Optimized the notification and charging logic of Death Summon.

16. Fixed the effect error on magic mark when it's ready to be unlocked.


Check Swarm the City's community and discuss with others about the game.
https://discord.gg/fQKHNHDcXP

Please do a survey for us so that we can get your feedback and know how to improve our game.
https://zh.surveymonkey.com/r/LCJR2YG?

And don't forget to add Swarm the City to your wishlist if you like it. :)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1597290/Swarm_the_City/

notes.title: First Patch 0517
notes.content:
Bug Fixing: 
1. Fixed the bug that sometimes some residents are still in the buildings after the buildings have been destroyed.
2. Fixed the bug that the unit property UI is not closed after repeatedly clicking it.
3. Fixed the bug that the gene icon would fly around when moving the scene while pausing.
4. Added the numerical description for two skills of talent tree: Enhance Infection and Enhance Infection II.
5. Fixed the bug that some text is displayed as code.

UI Optimization: 
1. Tutorial dialogs UI will now exist for a longer time
2. Added a close button in the upper right corner of mini-map UI after it's expanded
